LINK to my Power Index calculations and ranking methodology

SOS is calculated by:

determining the cumulative won/loss records of the team's opponents and the cumulative won/loss records of the teams' opponents' opponents. The formula shall be weighted two-third (66 2/3%) for the opponent's record and one-third (33 1/3%) for the opponents' opponents record....Should a team play a Division I-AA opponent, only the losses of the Division I-AA team shall be used in determining the opponent's record or the opponent's opponents' record.

I will present the rankings 2 ways. 1st with games played to date. This one will look the funkiest because there is not much data at this point. I'm presenting it mainly because it is interesting to see how the rankings change week to week as more games happen.

The other ranking will be based on predicting the outcomes of all other games. To do this I have calculated how much better (or worse) you have done scoring compared to your opponents. so for a game like Louisville-FSU...outside of that nightmare for the Noles, FSU's average game against 1A teams has been a 50-34.5 win. Louisville won by 43. that means that they were 58.5 points better than the average opponent FSU has played. you average out this difference for all games that a team has played to get the net "Points above replacement" for each team. if your PAR > than your opponents PAR, then the spreadsheet predicts a win. if not, it predicts a loss.
